tools.name: API Carro Chefe
tools.command: npm run db:generate && npx tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit

commands.linux: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_snapshot/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 tools/excel_snapshot/export.py --check
commands.darwin: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_snapshot/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 tools/excel_snapshot/export.py --check
commands.win32: python -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_snapshot/tests -p "test_*.py" -v && python tools/excel_snapshot/export.py --check

tools.name: Excel Recipe Engine V3B / Generic G1

commands.linux: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_recipe/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe validate tools/excel_recipe/examples/noop-carro-chefe.json && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe plan tools/excel_recipe/examples/probe-v2-tabela18.json && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3a_real && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3b_real
commands.darwin: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_recipe/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe validate tools/excel_recipe/examples/noop-carro-chefe.json && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe plan tools/excel_recipe/examples/probe-v2-tabela18.json && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3a_real && python3 -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3b_real
commands.win32: python -m unittest discover -s tools/excel_recipe/tests -p "test_*.py" -v && python -m tools.excel_recipe validate tools/excel_recipe/examples/noop-carro-chefe.json && python -m tools.excel_recipe plan tools/excel_recipe/examples/probe-v2-tabela18.json && python -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3a_real && python -m tools.excel_recipe.probe_v3b_real
